## Advisor angle
With the Fed signaling more hikes, advisors would likely spend client calls on rate risk. That means explaining why bond prices and gold have been under pressure, and revisiting whether portfolios match each client's tolerance. Headlines like Anthropic's debut also bring "should I buy it?" questions. Advisors need a ready answer about concentration and valuation.

## Term of the day: Hawkish
A "hawkish" central banker favors higher interest rates to fight inflation. Today's gold and dollar moves came after hawkish Fed comments: higher expected rates tend to strengthen the dollar and make non-interest-paying assets like gold less attractive.

## Interview talking point
"The Fed minutes suggest rate hikes aren't over, so I'd want to understand how a rising-rate environment changes the conversation with clients about bonds, cash, and risk."
